description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between fine-tuning method and performance, categorized by RoBERTa size. The horizontal axis displays the categories of fine-tuning methods – “BitFit”, “LoRA”, “S₁-model”, “S₄-model”, and “S₅-model” – with labels oriented vertically, and the bars are arranged in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “UE Performance”, represents a linear scale ranging from approximately 86 to 90, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Two sets of bars are presented for each fine-tuning method, representing “base” and “large” RoBERTa sizes, distinguished by blue and orange colors respectively. For the “BitFit” method, the “base” size bar reaches approximately 87.2, while the “large” size bar reaches approximately 88.5.  For the “S₅-model” method, the “base” size bar reaches approximately 89.8, and the “large” size bar reaches approximately 89.3.  Within each fine-tuning method, the two bars are positioned side-by-side, allowing for a visual comparison of performance between the “base” and “large” RoBERTa sizes. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
